title: Soar
description: Against the darkness of an early Florida morning, a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket tears through the sky, creating a portrait of humanity’s reach beyond Earth. At 6:33 a.m. ET on October 13, the rocket rose from the Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. Photographer Michael Seeley captured the entire spectacle in a single 426-second exposure across the Banana River, which saw the Falcon 9’s exhaust plume catching the rays of the rising sun while the landscape below remained in darkness.
translated_description: 在佛罗里达清晨的黑暗中，一枚SpaceX猎鹰9号火箭划破天空，勾勒出人类迈向地球之外的壮丽图景。美国东部时间10月13日早上6时33分，火箭从卡纳维拉尔角太空军基地40号航天发射复合体升空。摄影师迈克尔·西利在香蕉河对岸以单次426秒曝光捕捉到了这一完整奇观，画面中猎鹰9号的尾焰羽流映照着初升太阳的光芒，而下方大地仍笼罩在黑暗之中。
